gt_provenance.details: load_gsm8k() reads dataset from disk at /data/zhenqian/data/gsm8k; gold extracted via regex from dataset answer field (#### separator). No model output used as GT. Eval type: real_gt.

score_normalization.details: Raw accuracy = n_correct / n_items. Denominator is item count, not a model output statistic. Per-item delta computed against fixed neutral accuracy (0.820).

result_existence.details: 26 M2 result files exist and numbers match EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md (verified: neutral=0.820, happiness_1_human=0.708 matches Δ=-0.112). 8 M2b perturbation files exist, noise-floor p90=0.0524 correctly computed. WARN: per-item sign-consistency (required by C1 predicate) was NOT computed — EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md explicitly states this was skipped due to time. The sign-consistency half of C1 has no result file.

dead_code.details: All metric functions (parse_gsm8k, build_gsm8k_prompt, vllm_generate, hf_capture_activations) are called in main(). No dead metric code detected.

scope.details: 500/1319 GSM8K test items used — acceptable for ±4.5pp CI. However, sign-consistency predicate (required by C1 claim) was not evaluated for any of the 24 conditions. C1 requires BOTH macro-accuracy noise-floor AND sign-consistency; only the first was checked.
